study type: secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
outcome: correlation of factor XIII antigen with factor XIII activity
cohort: The study participants were 1300 parturient women at the University Hospital Zurich, Switzerland, observed between October 2015 and November 2016.
finding: Prepartum factor XIII activity significantly correlated with prepartum factor XIII antigen, and elevated prepartum factor XIII antigen showed a trend toward lower measured postpartum blood loss.
